'''Onyx Four''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] that served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Onyx Squadron/Legends|Onyx Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Onyx Four and other [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/sa]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] from Onyx Squadron participated in an [[Battle of Talus|attack]] on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Talus base|secret base]] within the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombing]] the planet to allow other Imperial forces to carry out a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]] on the facility.

==Description==
Manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]],<ref name="DB" /> Onyx Four was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="SWG card" />

==History==
[[File:Onyx_Squadron_Pilot_TIE_Aggressor_XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|Onyx Squadron, the Imperial Squadron in which Onyx Four served]]
Onyx Four was among the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/sa]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] serving in the Imperial [[Onyx Squadron/Legends|Onyx Squadron]] during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG card" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG timeline">Per the reasoning [[Template:SWG timeline|here]], the [[Battle of Talus]] occurs in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].</ref> the Empire discovered a [[Talus base|secret Alliance base]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. From an Imperial detachment's headquarters on the planet of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], an [[Battle of Talus|attack]] on the Alliance base was planned out, involving TIE/sa [[Starfighter/Legends|bombers]] from Onyx Squadron escorting Imperial [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to Talus in the hope that the element of surprise would lead to neutralizing the Alliance base.<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

During the same [[Standard day/Legends|night]], Onyx Four was among the squadron's [[Starship/Legends|bombers]] that carried through with the attack, [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombing]] the planet and allowing the Imperial transports to successfully land beside the Alliance base for a [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]] that ultimately ended with the base's [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defenders overpowering the Imperial ground forces and forcing them to retreat to a [[Talus Imperial Outpost|nearby Imperial outpost]].<ref name="DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Onyx Four was created in [[2008]] by ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'', an expansion set for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''. Appearing in the game's [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] campaign,<ref name="DS" /> the TIE/sa bomber was simultaneously identified by name by one of the game's cards.<ref name="SWG card" /> Onyx Four was drawn by [[Kieran Yanner]].<ref name="Game Interface">[[Sony]] Online Entertainment interface for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''</ref>
